title: Serializer does not skip hidden-type inputs, despite the spec's task text claiming it does
detail: Harmless today: the only hidden inputs in the SSR form are _-prefixed (_form_loaded_at at form_view.gleam:632, honeypot _website), so the `_` guard already covers them. But a future non-underscore hidden field would silently persist into drafts, contradicting the documented contract.
recommended_fix: Add `if (type === "hidden") return true;` to shouldSkipControl for defense-in-depth, and pin it with a form_draft.test.js case.

title: Continue-button chain uses Promise.finally, which the N10 capability gate does not check
detail: Browsers with fetch but no Promise.prototype.finally (Safari 10.1–11.0) pass the gate; the click handler then throws TypeError synchronously after `button.disabled = true`, leaving the button stuck disabled with no status copy. Near-zero 2026 impact, but it contradicts the gate's stated ancient-browser purpose.
recommended_fix: Replace `.finally(...)` with re-enabling the button inside both `.then` and `.catch`, or add `typeof Promise !== "undefined" && typeof Promise.prototype.finally === "function"` to the capability gate.
